name: SISO Foundry
summary: A source-mining and reuse-knowledge platform for discovering, evaluating, preserving, and navigating valuable external and SISO source.

reading.subtitle: Find what is worth reusing. Prove it before building on it.
reading.why: Good software already contains years of hard-won domain knowledge. Foundry makes that work discoverable and tests how it could serve a real business need, so each project does not have to start its research again. The Library preserves the resulting identities and receipts; Knowledge owns durable retrieval, and the product owner still decides what to adopt.

highlights.title: 17 industry research records
highlights.summary: Processes, existing software, candidate code, source evidence and falsifiable pilots. Values are unmeasured; read or fetch the same pinned research from any project.

highlights.title: What reusable code is worth
highlights.summary: The observed-value formula and ten existing-repository examples. Missing inputs remain unknown; evidence completeness is not a dollar value.

highlights.title: 9,636-repository evidence universe
highlights.summary: The v0.4.0 receipt anchors twenty scored applications and twelve evidence-qualified God Sources. These are dated findings, not a live inventory or automatic reuse permission.

highlights.title: Choose the adoption route
highlights.summary: The value matrix compares whole applications, APIs, sidecars, extraction, reference, and building. Each route carries proof gates, not just a popularity score.

highlights.title: Resumable discovery campaigns
highlights.summary: Versioned query contracts, checkpoints and source lineage make discovery repeatable. Candidate rights still require direct review before promotion.
